name: Knowing His Voice
overview: Scripture reveals that those who belong to God are able to hear and recognize His voice, distinguishing it from false voices. Jesus teaches that His sheep hear His voice, follow Him, and are known by Him, emphasizing the intimate relationship between the believer and the Savior. True hearing of God's words is evidence of being born of God, while those who reject His voice do so because they are not of Him. Moreover, obedience to Christ's commandments demonstrates love for Him, resulting in a deeper manifestation of His presence to the believer.
